long_biography.plain_text:
Tower-crane rental gave civil engineer Paul Giorgetti a concrete way to broaden his family's construction business. With brother Marc, he created Skyliners, which grew into one of the group's largest subsidiaries and a market leader in Luxembourg and the Greater Region. The company added equipment supply to a business already known for major building and infrastructure projects.

Under the brothers' direction, Félix Giorgetti broadened beyond general contracting through property development, building management, road materials and quarry interests. Acquisitions such as TDO Consulting and asphalt producer Julien Cajot added design, facilities and production capacity, while quarry investment tightened control of the supply chain. The group has since delivered roads, bridges, tunnels, offices, housing and public infrastructure across Luxembourg.
